purpose: Run and evaluate a batch-stable DenseOn corrective replication of the AdamW, Muon, and NorMuon comparison.

design_context.classification: post-diagnosis corrective replication with prospectively locked corrected outcomes

training.input_execution: SentenceTransformers can_flatten_inputs=false, independently padded within each of the eight explicit text columns
training.completion_rule: A run is complete only if all five deeply audited checkpoints, the final model, accepted timing ledger, and independently_padded execution receipt agree.
training.failure_rule: Never drop or replace a failed high-rate run. Retry only from a deeply valid checkpoint. Persistent numerical failure is an optimizer-stability result and prevents a complete-grid superiority claim.

evaluation.benchmark: the same 14 pinned decontaminated BEIR tasks used by the historical Dense study
evaluation.retrieval: exact full-corpus scoring with the existing pinned task revisions and evaluator contract

validation_selection.rule: Within each optimizer, choose the final-checkpoint learning rate with minimum mean contrastive loss across all 4096 rows; ties choose the lower learning rate. BEIR is not an input.

analysis.primary_estimand: At the final checkpoint, average nDCG@10 over the four predeclared learning rates within optimizer for each task, then contrast Muon-AdamW, NorMuon-AdamW, and NorMuon-Muon across the 14 paired tasks.
analysis.primary_uncertainty: 50,000 paired task bootstraps with seed 20260903; simultaneous max-T 95% intervals over the three optimizer contrasts.
analysis.primary_support_rule: An optimizer-family advantage is supported only when its simultaneous 95% interval versus AdamW lies wholly above zero and all four rates completed. An interval wholly below zero supports a disadvantage; otherwise report inconclusive.
analysis.secondary_estimand: Compare the validation-selected recipe per optimizer on final-checkpoint mean nDCG@10 using the same paired max-T procedure; label this secondary.
analysis.training_dynamics: Report every optimizer-rate-task checkpoint, optimizer-level stage means, and trapezoidal area over normalized progress. Dynamics are descriptive unless an interval procedure is explicitly added without changing the primary rule.
analysis.stability: Report completion, non-finite values, gradient norms, peak memory, accepted wall time, checkpoint bytes, and optimizer-state bytes for every run.
analysis.weight_space: At all five checkpoints, report update norm, update-to-weight ratio, singular-value effective/stable rank, top-subspace overlap with AdamW, and representation/retrieval bridges. These mechanism analyses are secondary and cannot substitute for the primary retrieval contrast.
analysis.historical_bridge: Compare corrected and historical rankings/deltas descriptively as an execution-path sensitivity analysis; do not pool their checkpoints into one causal estimate.

claim_boundary: The corrected experiment can support claims about this pinned DenseOn model, 500k-query seven-negative data view, and optimizer grids. One training seed and the known post-hoc origin preclude a universal optimizer claim; LateOn is outside scope.
